title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
inputFormat: Implement maxPathSum(root). The runner converts the level-order input array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: The largest sum along a non-empty path of distinct, edge-connected nodes. The path may begin and end anywhere in the tree.

visuals.title: The best path need not include the root
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 255" role="img" aria-label="Maximum path 15 to 20 to 7 has sum 42; root minus 10 is excluded" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M190 30L95 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M190 30L285 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M285 105L235 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M285 105L335 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="190" cy="30" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="190" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">-10</text><circle cx="95" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="95" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">9</text><circle cx="285" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="285" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">20</text><circle cx="235" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="235" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">15</text><circle cx="335" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="335" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">7</text><text x="190" y="220" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">15 + 20 + 7 = 42</text></svg>
visuals.caption: The highlighted path uses both children of 20 and skips the negative root.
